name: Fey Wild Shape (Mythic)
body:
Your wild shape gains a number of fey abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Fey Wild Shape.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend two additional daily uses of your wild shape class feature and 2 points of mythic power to add the fey creature template to your animal form. You can select new fey special abilities every time you change into a fey creature wild shape.
